notes.title: The Admin update Version 1.1
notes.content:
The Admin V1.1
The Admin update version 1.1 is now live, here are the changes included in this version:
•	Player Respawn bug fix
•	Objective markers stuck on screen fix
•	Performance improvements through AI, Codes and models optimization
•	Improved Textures and lighting quality
•	Character Animations changes
•	Added new sound and visual effects
•	Changes in game UI and Skill Menu
•	Skills cool down progress now visible on skill icons
•	Enemy health bar relocated to the top of the screen
•	Targeting system tweaked, targeted enemy has mark on them
•	The Admin now do "heavy slash" when player hold the left click when not aiming the gun
Heavy slash effects differ based on the equipped sword
